page_metadata.title: Adapting existing toxicokinetic models to relate perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl intake to biomarkers in humans

model_classification.evidence_quote: Schematic for the three-compartment model (Vc, Vt, Vfil) with a saturable resorption process (Tm, Kt) adapted from Wambaugh et al. (2013) and Andersen et al. (2006); CPrim, CDeep, and Cfil are the chemical concentrations in the primary/central, deep/second, and filtrate compartments.
